purpose: Why Cholesky and triangular solves are in-house by default, and what the change does to results

blas_finding.source: cloud correctness diagnostic of commit f8c30d5 (Release, OpenMP, GCC 12.3.0) on an Intel Xeon 6975P-C; no timing

correct_kernels_same_library.SkylakeX: errors at most 1e-15 at every order

blas_finding.rapidglm_tests_default_kernel: 15,450 failed assertions, all in the two Cholesky tests above 16 columns; 20/20 CLI tests pass
blas_finding.not_established: the upstream defect; behaviour of other OpenBLAS versions

change: in-house Cholesky (factor, solve, inverse, exact condition number) at every order and in-house QR back substitution and (R'R)^-1; CMake option RAPIDGLM_LAPACK_SOLVES restores LAPACK above 16 columns and for the QR triangular solves

output_comparison.host: local server, pthread OpenBLAS 0.3.20 (Haswell kernel), 12 threads, untimed

tests: ctest and tests/test_cli.py pass in both configurations; qr_large_system_solution_and_inverse added (65 columns)
